presentation.label: Track Solo
presentation.summary: Hold TRK and UP to hear the active track alone, or latch it with TRK + DOWN; the stock mutes stay as they were.
presentation.overview: Track Solo, by ceredmeat, lets you hear one track on its own and snap back to the full pattern. Hold TRK, then hold UP: the active track plays alone for as long as you hold UP, and you can let go of TRK. Hold TRK and press DOWN to latch the solo; TRK + DOWN again unlatches it, and on another track moves the solo there. While a solo is on, S and the track number (S3) show in the top-right corner. The other tracks' notes just don't start: notes already sounding ring out, delay and reverb tails keep going, lock trigs still apply, and the stock mutes are never touched. It works on audio and MIDI tracks.
highlights: Hold TRK + UP: the active track plays alone while UP is held.
TRK + DOWN latches the solo; again unlatches it, or moves it to another track.
S and the track number show in the top-right corner while a solo is on.
The stock mutes are never touched; tails ring out and lock trigs still apply.
usage: Play a pattern with several tracks.
Select a track, hold TRK, then hold UP: only that track plays, and S with its number shows in the top-right corner.
Let go of UP: every track plays again.
Hold TRK and press DOWN to latch the solo; press TRK + DOWN again to unlatch it.

access.location: Any page: TRK + UP, TRK + DOWN
steps: Use a build containing Track Solo for the original Digitakt on OS 1.54; seq-events comes with it.
Select a track, hold TRK and hold UP to solo it while UP is held.
Hold TRK and press DOWN to latch the solo.

controls.name: TRK + UP (hold)
controls.doc: Solo the active track while UP is held; you can let go of TRK.

controls.name: TRK + DOWN
controls.doc: Latch the solo on the active track; again to unlatch, or on another track to move it. S and the track number show in the top-right corner while a solo is on.

limitations: Needs core 4.1 or newer, so it does not build beside Digi EQ 1.0.2, which builds only on core 2.1.
Not with Euclidean: seq-events, which Track Solo builds on, patches the same step-fire sites.
Only note trigs are held back: notes already sounding and effect tails ring out.

load.display: Answers one question per step in the sequencer, nothing in the audio render
load.conditions: From the source: its ev_fire_trig handler returns at once unless a solo is on, then compares the track; its other handlers run on the UI side (ev_key, ev_tick, ev_draw). seq-events adds its step-fire routines. Not measured on a unit in Modwerk.

hardware.summary: The author tested Track Solo 0.2 on a Digitakt MKI on OS 1.54 together with nine other FLEXMODS mods, elekloader's core and seq-events (FLEXMODS 1.0, 16 November 2026). Modwerk builds seq-events from Dracyr's source in elekloader 0.11.0, the same interface as the seq-events 0.1 it was tested with; this module pins the author's released Track Solo file.
limitations: The author's report gives no duration: testedOn is the FLEXMODS 1.0 release date.
Tested with elekloader's core and other FLEXMODS mods in the build, not with Modwerk's library mods.
Not tested in Modwerk on a unit.

tests.summary: The author's released 0.2 file, pinned unchanged, linked locally on OS 1.54 with core 4.4 and Modwerk's seq-events 0.1.0 beside every Digitakt mod in the library. Emulator captures show where it appears; nothing ran on a unit in Modwerk.
